edges.reason: flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
withdrawAll invokes internal _withdraw once per recipient.
withdrawAll reads the contract balance into local variable.
_withdraw performs a low-level external call with value, enabling reentrancy before state is finalized.
_withdraw uses _amount as the transferred value.
_withdraw uses _address as the call target.
withdrawAll is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender to owner.
mintGem mints new tokens to msg.sender.
reserveTokens mints reserved tokens to msg.sender.
flipSaleState is guarded by onlyOwner based on msg.sender.
mintGem uses numberOfTokens in price and supply arithmetic.
gemPrice is multiplied by numberOfTokens to check msg.value.
MAX_NFT_PURCHASE bounds the per-purchase token count.
MAX_SUPPLY bounds the total mintable supply.
mintGem requires saleIsActive to be true.
mintGem performs SafeMath mul/add over user-controlled values.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient (msg.sender), an external callback.
reserveGems mints tokens to the _to parameter.
reserveGems loops _reserveAmount times to mint tokens.
reserveGems checks supply against MAX_SUPPLY.
reserveTokens checks supply against MAX_SUPPLY.
reserveTokens stores totalSupply in the local supply variable.
calcStartingIndex reads and writes startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive the index.
calcStartingIndex applies modulo MAX_SUPPLY to the block hash.
calcStartingIndex relies on blockhash/block.number, a weak block-variable dependency.
calcStartingIndex computes startingIndex via blockhash modulo arithmetic.
setProvenanceHash consumes the provenanceHash parameter.
setProvenanceHash writes the VOG_PROVENANCE state variable.
setProvenanceHash is guarded by onlyOwner based on msg.sender.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock sets startingIndexBlock from block.number.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is guarded by onlyOwner based on msg.sender.
setBaseURI consumes the baseURI_ parameter.
setBaseURI writes the _baseURIExtended state variable.
setBaseURI is guarded by onlyOwner based on msg.sender.
_baseURI returns the _baseURIExtended state variable.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the base string.
tokenURI uses tokenId for existence checks and URI lookup.
tokenURI reads the _tokenURIs mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used as the mint recipient inside reserveGems.
_reserveAmount only controls the mint loop inside reserveGems.
numberOfTokens exists solely as the mint count argument of mintGem.
provenanceHash is only assigned to VOG_PROVENANCE inside setProvenanceHash.
baseURI_ is only written to _baseURIExtended inside setBaseURI.
tokenId is only used for URI lookup and existence checks in tokenURI.
_address is only used as the low-level call target in _withdraw.
_amount is only used as the transferred value in _withdraw.
balance is a temporary local caching address(this).balance in withdrawAll.
supply is a temporary local caching totalSupply() in reserveTokens and reserveGems.
